title: AQP_HSPC: image-analysis pipelines for Kondrychyn et al., "Osmo-hydraulic volume regulation ensures robust endothelial-to-haematopoietic transition"

creators.name: Chen, Yan
creators.affiliation: RIKEN Center for Biosystems Dynamics Research, Kobe, Japan

description: Two independent Python pipelines. calcium_imaging/ turns Fiji-exported GCaMP ROI time-series into analysis tables, QC reports, statistics and the figures for Figure 5 and Supplementary Figures 9 and 10, plus the Source Data workbook. LPM_migration/ performs StarDist segmentation and trackpy-based nuclear tracking of lateral plate mesoderm cells for Figure 2c-h. Code only; raw imaging data are not included.
